title: ATS analysis, v1 (draft)
description: Response of POST /v1/analyze. The request is multipart/form-data with one field, `file`, containing a PDF. Clients ignore properties they do not know, so new ones can be added within v1. Draft: expect changes until both owners mark it stable.

score.description: Overall score from 0 to 100, or null when the analyser could not produce one.

id.description: Stable identifier for the kind of finding, e.g. missing-contact-email.

message.description: Plain-English explanation shown to the user.

suggestion.description: What to change, if the analyser has a concrete suggestion.
